//nodeModulesDir: The Silero VAD is onnxruntime-node, a native Node-API module, and it needs
a real node_modules directory on disk. Deno will create one silently when
it notices; pinned here so the requirement is visible rather than implicit,
and so a future reader knows removing it breaks speech detection.
//minimumDependencyAge: Deno refuses npm packages younger than 24 hours, which is a supply-chain
protection worth keeping. `exclude` lifts it for one package only — proven
by A/B: with npm:vxasr excluded the install passes, and with a different
package excluded vxasr is blocked again, so the policy still guards
vxasr is exempt because it is this project's own upstream (dtinth/vxbeamer):
the risk the delay buys time against is a compromised third-party publisher,
and here the publisher is us. Nothing else should be added to this list
